Name: Hay Silo Updated
Author: VasVadum
Description:
So you got tired of seeing that old hay silo made of ugly metal and towering over everything right? You just wanted to lay by the bay making some clay then stay and lay for a while, looking at a nice pile of hay. Well, now you can!

This is a content patched updated version of Hay Silo.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1519]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1519[/url]

The original uploader is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48166143]Flor3nce2456[/url]. The original author listed on his mod is "[b]E_Wang[/b]".
I pestered a friend into helping patch the mod up to work in Content Patcher, and he didn't wanna upload so I am.

The original mod has no permissions on it, which seems to indicate that its free to upload and edit. Anyone else who uploads must abide by the original permissions, and thus my upload has the same permissions.

---
If the original author/uploader comes back around, he's free to take this over to his page and I will delete this. Though he will need to change the updatekey in the manifest file and I can change the manifest in this to reference his instead for a while to give people a chance to switch over.

I also used his mod's screenshots to preserve the mod's original previews and such. Anyone can add their own screenshots.

Manifest.Name: Hay Silos
Manifest.Description: CP version of Flor3nce2456's Hay Silos
